product.title: 4-Day Half Dome Backpacking Adventure

description.text: There’s only one way to get away from the crowds in Yosemite: backcountry adventures. On this four-day tour, meet your expert guide in Yosemite Valley and set out to see the park in its true majesty, exploring Happy Isles, Sunrise Creek, and the Half Dome cables with camp meals cooked by your guide.

highlights: Backpack with an expert guide for tips, tricks, and excellent camp meals
Comfort provisions provided for good nights' sleep
Explore lesser-trafficked spots like Sunrise Creek in addition to Half Dome
A maximum of 8 backpackers makes this an intimate backcountry adventure

start.description: Meet your guide in Half Dome Village (Curry Village) in Yosemite Valley for a pre-trip briefing and gear check before entering the backcountry.

end.description: Finish the backpacking loop back in Yosemite Valley after the Half Dome summit day.

product.itinerarySummary: There’s only one way to get away from the crowds in Yosemite: backcountry adventures.

itineraryItems.title: Yosemite Valley
itineraryItems.description: Meet your guide and prepare for the backcountry trek through Yosemite Valley.

itineraryItems.title: Happy Isles
itineraryItems.description: Begin the trail from Happy Isles toward the Mist Trail corridor.

itineraryItems.title: Little Yosemite Valley
itineraryItems.description: Camp and acclimatize in Little Yosemite Valley before the Half Dome push.

itineraryItems.title: Half Dome
itineraryItems.description: Summit Half Dome via the cables on the highlight day of the trek.

itineraryItems.title: Sunrise Creek
itineraryItems.description: Explore Sunrise Creek and surrounding backcountry on the return route.
